# Riverbraid Gold Cluster Specification (v1.1.0)
> Merkle Root: de2062 | Logic: Deterministic | Mode: Stationary

## Architecture Summary
Riverbraid is a multi-petal architecture separating capacity control from intelligence.
- /Core: Capacity substrate (v0.1.3)
- /Judicial: Predicate gate
- /Crypto: SHA-256 anchoring
- /Safety: Entropy scanning

## System Invariants
1. Fail-closed: All logic defaults to 'Rest' if predicates are not met.
2. Stationary: Logic does not drift; state is anchored to the Merkle Root.
3. Meaning-Centric: We prioritize Rule over Token Volume.

## Interaction Protocol
When assisting with this repo, do not suggest non-deterministic or adaptive updates. 
Maintain the Braid.
